description_for_human: Publish and update websites; store files privately.
description_for_model: Publish and update static websites and files. Manage bucket files, versions, access settings, forms, and analytics. Private storage follows the Terms of Use; previews and publications follow the Website Publishing Policy. Signup is browser-only. Connect an existing account through OAuth for hosted MCP or the CLI browser sign-in flow. Never ask users to paste credentials in chat. Check publication status before reporting success. The OpenAPI document covers selected REST endpoints; see api.md for the complete API.
